BiblicalUsage: Meriyruwth is bitterness, grief made audible. Ezekiel 21:6 commands the prophet to sigh with the breaking of his loins, and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God asked Ezekiel to carry the grief in his own body, so the people would see the judgment coming before they felt it.
